answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 32438 Country: India Title: I want to know that how we should settle down the seat of w.c in toilet. Question: I want to know that how we should settle down the seat of w.c in toilet. is it right to sit facing our backside toward QUIBLA/west in the toilet. Answer ID: 32438 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 909/756/B=1432) You should fix the seat of Western commode in toilet in a way that when you sit for your nature's call your face and back is not towards the Qiblah: عن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم – إنما أنا لكم بمنزلة الوالد أعلمكم فإذا أتى أحدكم الغائط فلا يستقبل القبلة ولا يستدبرها الخ ابوداؤد ص 3 Note: The answer is correct, but it is makrooh to install western style commode in toilets. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
